items.raw_excerpt: Rosie Fordham is already Australia's most successful cross-country ski racer in history, and she relished a reminder of the sport's growing popularity as she won the Kangaroo Hoppet. But she has her sights set on getting even better.
items.summary_en: Rosie Fordham won the Kangaroo Hoppet cross-country ski race. She is already the best cross-country skier in Australian history. The race is getting more popular and more people are coming to watch. She wants to keep improving.
items.summary_ko: 로지 포드햄이 캥거루 호펫 크로스컨트리 스키 경기에서 우승했다. 그녀는 이미 호주 역사상 가장 뛰어난 크로스컨트리 스키 선수다. 이 경기는 점점 더 인기를 얻고 있으며 관람하러 오는 사람도 늘고 있다. 그녀는 계속 더 잘하기를 바란다.
items.title_en: Australian skier wins big cross-country race, wants to do better

items.title_original: How Rosie Fordham leads the way in a race 'everybody comes out for'

items.raw_excerpt: The Volta deposit-return scheme in Portugal has already seen millions of bottles and cans returned, but consumers may have noticed that the way they receive their €0.10 deposit back varies depending on where they use the machine.
items.summary_en: Portugal's Volta deposit-return scheme has collected millions of bottles and cans. But people get their 10 cent deposit back in different ways. Some machines refund it to a bank card and others do not.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈의 볼타 병 보증금 제도는 수백만 개의 병과 캔을 수거해 왔습니다. 하지만 소비자들은 수거기에 따라 10센트 보증금을 돌려받는 방식이 다르다는 점을 눈치챘을 수 있습니다. 어떤 기기는 은행 카드로 환급해 주지만, 어떤 기기는 그렇지 않습니다.
items.title_en: Why some bottle machines give back money by card and others don't

items.raw_excerpt: Para swimmer Jenna Jones claimed breakthrough gold at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games, and her dog is proving to be a surprise sporting companion.
items.summary_en: Para swimmer Jenna Jones won a gold medal at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games. Her dog Luna has become her sporting companion. The dog shares in her gold medal victories.

items.raw_excerpt: While security cameras are a regular feature in many supermarkets, new technology could change the face of how businesses monitor customers.
items.summary_en: Australian supermarkets like Coles and Woolworths have tested facial recognition technology to fight retail theft. The technology builds a detailed map of a person's face to identify who they are. Privacy groups worry this could be misused to track shoppers.
items.summary_ko: 콜스와 울워스 같은 호주 마트들이 매장 도난을 막기 위해 얼굴 인식 기술을 시험했다. 이 기술은 사람 얼굴을 자세히 지도처럼 만들어 누군지 알아낸다. 개인정보 보호 단체들은 쇼핑객 추적에 악용될 수 있다고 우려한다.
items.title_en: Will supermarkets scan your face with facial recognition?
